rules.constraint: Enforce record permissions at the trusted boundary.
rules.task: Reuse ownership checks for each private read/write.
rules.acceptance: Wrong-owner requests fail; permitted requests work, including direct requests.
rules.verification: Test both owners and denied writes; record actual results.

rules.constraint: Reuse maintained authentication; do not invent crypto.
rules.task: Inspect and reuse supported sign-in and session handling.
rules.acceptance: Invalid credentials fail; legitimate sign-in works.
rules.verification: Test invalid and valid sign-in with disposable accounts.

rules.constraint: Protect sessions and state changes for the actual auth design.
rules.task: Use supported session expiry/logout and applicable CSRF defenses.
rules.acceptance: Expired or forged session actions fail; valid actions work.
rules.verification: Test session expiry and cross-origin state changes using stack guidance.
